topic.label: Grammar of Modern Languages
topic.desc: Grammar of Modern Languages: Italian Grammar and Syntax, Japanese Grammar, Korean Grammar, French Grammar and Usage, German Grammar and Usage and Spanish Language Acquisition.

concepts.label: French Grammar and Usage
concepts.desc: Morphology and syntax of French: verb conjugation, tense and mood, agreement, pronouns and register.

concepts.label: German Grammar and Usage
concepts.desc: German morphology and syntax: cases, declension, verb position, separable verbs, modal verbs and the subjunctive.

concepts.label: Italian Grammar and Syntax
concepts.desc: Morphology and syntax of standard Italian: articles, agreement, verb conjugation, moods, tenses, clitic pronouns and word order.

concepts.label: Japanese Grammar
concepts.desc: Particles, verb and adjective conjugation, sentence-final forms, clause linking and word order.

concepts.label: Korean Grammar
concepts.desc: Particles, verb endings, conjugation, connective endings and sentence structure in Korean.

concepts.label: Spanish Language Acquisition
concepts.desc: Building Spanish proficiency in speaking, listening, reading and writing, from basic grammar to advanced composition.

skills.label: Conjugation Drill
skills.desc: Generates conjugations across tenses and moods for regular and irregular verbs and checks every form against a reference conjugation table.

skills.label: Written Error Correction
skills.desc: Corrects agreement, tense and pronoun errors in a learner text and checks each correction with an explained grammar rule.

skills.label: Register Adjustment
skills.desc: Rewrites a text between familiar, standard and formal French and checks vocabulary and tu or vous usage match the target register.

skills.label: Case and Declension Drill
skills.desc: Generates article and adjective endings across nominative, accusative, dative and genitive and checks each against declension tables.

skills.label: Subjunctive Usage Practice
skills.desc: Builds Konjunktiv I and II sentences for reported speech and hypotheticals and checks forms against conjugation tables.

skills.label: Word Order Correction
skills.desc: Corrects verb-second, verb-final and separable verb placement in learner sentences and checks each fix with the rule.

skills.label: Verb Conjugator
skills.desc: Conjugates Italian verbs in every mood and tense including irregular forms, checked against standard conjugation tables.

skills.label: Grammar Correction
skills.desc: Corrects errors in Italian text and explains each rule, checked by citing the rule for every change.

skills.label: Subjunctive Trainer
skills.desc: Generates exercises on when the congiuntivo is required, checked by an answer key with the trigger for each item.

skills.label: Verb and Adjective Conjugator
skills.desc: Conjugates Japanese verbs and adjectives into each form, checked against conjugation class rules.

skills.label: Grammar Correction
skills.desc: Corrects errors in Japanese sentences and explains each fix, checked by citing the rule used.

skills.label: Particle Explainer
skills.desc: Explains particle choice such as wa versus ga in a sentence, checked by giving contrasting example sentences.

skills.label: Verb Conjugator
skills.desc: Conjugates Korean verbs and adjectives with endings and irregular stems, checked against conjugation rules.

skills.label: Grammar Correction
skills.desc: Corrects errors in Korean sentences and explains each fix, checked by citing the rule used.

skills.label: Particle Explainer
skills.desc: Explains particle choice such as eun versus i in context, checked with contrasting example sentences.

skills.label: Composition Feedback Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews a Spanish composition for grammar, vocabulary and coherence by proficiency level, checked by a second grammar pass.

skills.label: Conjugation Drill Generator
skills.desc: Generates verb conjugation exercises across tenses and moods with answer keys checked against standard conjugation tables.

skills.label: Subjunctive Usage Coach
skills.desc: Explains when the subjunctive is required and corrects learner sentences, checked against grammar references.
